classification: Derived constants and state topology, not learned parameters
interval_rounding: round to nearest, ties to even; inclusive endpoints

gate.open_rule: short EMA > 0; otherwise remain shown only while long EMA > 0.02

arithmetic.forward: float64; increasing state/predecessor order; portable transcendental functions
arithmetic.viterbi: float32 log transition, observation and prior; separately rounded additions and max subtraction; first predecessor wins ties
arithmetic.phase: integer position divided by integer interval in float64
arithmetic.tempo_class: nearest log-frequency among 61 classes from 30 through 300 BPM; first class wins ties

silence: Digital-zero hop closes both evidence EMAs and presentation; 94 consecutive digital-zero hops cold-reset both decoders and upstream histories. Short gaps preserve committed history.
